profile.headline: Engineering Lead → AI Product & Team Leadership | Agentic R&D | GenAI Application Development | Cloud Architecture
profile.summary:
Agentic AI is moving from demos to production. I help teams ship it.

At NICE ElevateAI, I architect and lead delivery of production-grade agentic systems — multi-agent orchestration, MCP server integrations, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication platforms, and full SDLC automation pipelines. I'm not experimenting with AI. I'm running it in SOC2+HITRUST-compliant enterprise environments at scale.


Over 12 years across healthcare, enterprise SaaS, and AI-as-a-Service, I've developed a skillset enables me to wear many hats, I can design the system architecture, own the technical roadmap, align cross-functional stakeholders, and mentor the engineers executing it — all in the same role.


A few things I'm proud of:

→ Boosted transcription performance 80%, driving 30% user growth at ElevateAI 
→ Expanded multilingual AI support from 4 to 90 languages in production → Built a multi-agent code review system that cut manual review time by 40% 
→ Coordinated 60+ offshore engineers as part of a 3-person US team at athenahealth → Led R&D from concept to pitch as Engineering Lead on Team RAPID

I
'm targeting my next role as a Technical Program Manager, Engineering Lead, or Software Architect in AI, agentic systems, or cloud-native product development — somewhere the work is genuinely hard and the domain is moving fast.


If you're building serious AI infrastructure and need someone who can lead the technical vision and devleopment and drive delivery end-to-end — let's talk.


📬 NimeshPatelxTech@gmail.com | stacked-software.com

positions.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
•       Architected and built A2A (agent to agent) chatbot functionality.
•       Architected and built multi-agent AI workflow system using Claude Code CLI with specialized subagents for automated code review, testing, and deployment hooks.
•	Designed and deployed full-stack AI-powered applications using React, Next.js, Vercel, and Supabase with end-to-end CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions
•	Engineered agentic development pipelines leveraging Claude Agent SDK and Anthropic API, orchestrating multiple AI agents for parallel code generation, review, and documentation
•	Built CI/CD infrastructure using GitHub Actions for automated testing, building, and zero-downtime deployments to Vercel with automatic rollback on failures
•	Developed Supabase-backed applications with PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security, real-time subscriptions, and edge functions for scalable multi-tenant AI solutions
•	Implemented AI-assisted code review hooks integrated into Git workflows, automating detection of security vulnerabilities and code quality issues before human review
•	Established best practices and documentation for AI-first software development workflows, mentoring team members on Claude Code CLI, prompt engineering, and agentic architecture patterns

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer, NiCE ElevateAi
positions.description:
Spearheaded the development and successful launch of “Echo,” an advanced transcription and language-processing platform leveraging generative AI to:
	•	Boost Performance & Accuracy: Drove a 90% improvement in large language model (LLM) inference speed and accuracy.
	•	Expand Global Reach: Grew supported languages from 4 to 75, significantly increasing multilingual accessibility.
	•	Streamline Data Handling: Implemented robust file output capabilities for efficient data storage, annotation, and analysis.
	•	Integrate Reliable Messaging: Adopted RabbitMQ for scalable queuing, ensuring high throughput and enhanced system stability.
	•	Automate Quality Assurance: Developed comprehensive unit tests, improving maintainability and accelerating release cycles.
	•	Drive Innovation: Created an entirely new transcription engine and pioneered novel generative AI approaches for refined language insights.
	•	Achieve Real-World Impact: Successfully launched to production, leading to a substantial increase in user adoption and engagement

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Revamped monolithic application architecture for improved performance, scalability, and maintainability
•Enhanced app performance by 40% through strategic refactoring and microservices. Pioneered a custom security framework, integrating Azure B2C for robust user authz and authn.
• Refactored monolithic codebase into more scalable microservices architecture
• Implemented API integration tests and unit tests to ensure code quality
• Utilized Redis for high-performance data retrieval and Azure Blob Storage for cheap scalable file storage
•Partnered with cross-functional teams to streamline frontend/backend communication via RESTful APIs. Engineered a scalable, secure cloud infrastructure, optimizing operational efficiency.

positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Technical Solution Design · Swagger API · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Debugging · Architectural Design · Technology Adoption · Application Security

positions.title: Software Salaried Professional
positions.description:
Met with prospective clients to get a understanding of what they are looking for and working through IT solutions.
Create a web application serving hundreds of vendors and thousands of users to forecast, acknowledge orders and ship parts to a manufacturing plant. 
Creating parameterized reports.
Worked with multiple stakeholders to gather requirements and make the vision a reality.
Developed application using ASP.NET, VB.NET, HTML, Javascript, Jquery, WCF, SQL Server, T-SQL.
Developed and consumed WCF Services to achieve Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and extensibility for the ability of communication between heterogeneous applications.
Implemented Web Services to integrate the client systems using WCF.
Implemented a rich user interface using controls such as Gridview, Datatables, and Lists to input and view data.
Developed the Login control, token-based authentication, administration of user with email based validation of user.
Utilized entity framework for data retrieval
Developed and utilized stored procedures to query and CRUD data.
Enabled mechanisms for exports data via Excel, CSV and PDF formats.
Enabled validation on client and server side.
Worked with end user testers to identify bugs and fix.
Created barcodes and shipping labels for vendors to send parts
Developed WCF services to enable effective communication.
Cleaned up and optimized code for web application  to clear up bottlenecks for end user that lead to long user load times.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Solution Design · Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Debugging · Architectural Design · Technology Adoption · Application Security

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Electronic cloud health records software. My team is responsible for creating new inpatient software.          
Developer 
Utilized SSRS to create reports for the application in conjunction with Tableau to create informative dashboards.
Design of ETL DTS Packages & SSIS Packages for integrating data and transformations provided by SSIS.
Developed software requirements with the business as part of a scrum team .
Designing and creating new software that is easily maintainable and extensible
Using HL7 and XML to integrate healthcare software
Working with Mirth to send create integrations with other hospital software.
Specified, designed, created, and configured SQL Servers
Ensured correct and optimal utilization of hardware, file systems, and physical storage on all systems
Designed logical and physical database for reporting tool, generating various monthly financial & end user reports and send them to the end users. Also generated reports in different formats such as csv, pdf, etc.
Design and development of client/server, web based and n-tier applications
Utilized .net and the Microsoft stack for cloud development
Part of a team that is offshore and in other locations in USA
Using perforce as our revision system
My team is one of the first teams that started working in the agile software methodology, and we are coaching other teams on this methodology
Working with Mirth to send create integrations with other hospital software.
Working with vendors and the government state agencies such as the CDC to transfer health information to their servers in real time
Attained Meaningful Use stage 3 for our clients through developing our software, which lead to direct positive correlation of the sales of our inpatient software
Creating front-end user interfaces using HTML5, JavaScript and CSS3
Creating application logic using C#
Used SSIS to create reports
Using RESTful to develop web services and API’s for communication of data between different applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Integration Development · Mentoring · Debugging · Architectural Design · Technology Adoption

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A startup that is an all in one electronic health software tool for inpatient and outpatient clinics. This company started in 2011 and eventually sold for $40M in 2014 to athenahealth.
Software Engineer
Creating reports utilizing Tableau.
Integral part of the team (2nd on shore developer hired)
Team Foundation Server for source control and reporting/tracking bugs and development work
Part of an intimate team of 3 developers in the United States, we managed 60 off-shore developers
Developed Health Level Seven software for communicating with other health IT vendors
Developed Android app using an Agile methodology
Attained Meaningful Use Stage 2 for hospitals through developing our software which lead to a direct positive correlation of the sale of our software
Developed and modified SharePoint user privileges as directed and in compliance with all standard operating procedures
Creating SharePoint sites for teams for increased productivity for their job functions.
Expert at HL7, utilized Mirth and in house platform to connect to different healthcare software systems including, Lab, Pharmacy, Radiology, Billing  software systems

positions.description:
IT Community Vice President
Organized meetings and lunches with industry leaders for Co-Ops to learn from.
Meeting with clients and make enhancements to various multi-tier business applications and processes.
Modified sites in SharePoint 
Good experience working with a team of developers 
Maintaining enterprise level applications and working with users to debug code.
Creating and editing business financial reports using VB6 and macros in MS Excel.
